premises.text: Insurance brokers cannot rebate commissions to clients but can provide services for free
premises.evidence_span: it's illegal for them to rebate any portion of that commission to their clients. So I can't give you guys money back, but what I can do is provide a whole lot of services and software for free on my platform

premises.text: Zenefits offers HR as a service platform that manages payroll and benefits for free
premises.evidence_span: we announced the launch of our HR as a service platform, where we take on and manage all of your payroll, all of your benefits, all of the associated HR administrative work that comes with those systems. And this is important. We do all of it for free

premises.text: Existing payroll and benefits systems can be connected to Zenefits' platform without re-enrollment
premises.evidence_span: if you already have payroll and benefits, you don't have to set anything up. You don't have to re-enroll or switch anything. You can just connect your existing systems to our platform

premises.text: Zenefits can automate HR processes, reducing administrative work for clients
premises.evidence_span: we can start to mechanize it. We can start to replace people and paper with software and technology

premises.text: 80% of HR work is administrative and can be outsourced to Zenefits
premises.evidence_span: HR is only 20% strategic, things like who you hire, the kind of culture that you create. 80% of it is administrative

premises.text: Switching to Zenefits is disruptive for traditional HR outsourcing companies
premises.evidence_span: that's going to be very disruptive for a group of companies whose clients have never before today had a reason to switch

value.text: Clients can manage HR processes more efficiently and at no cost
value.evidence_span: if we can sort of automate that stuff, if we can take all these headaches off your hands, that's got to be something that's got to make sense for you to switch to us

notes: Traction details and demo offers excluded as they do not constitute premises.
